text: Figure 7.1: Log mode As shown in the diagram, once the log mode is set to use the Logging backend the configuration is of that backend is centralized in the Machine manifest configu- ration. For example, the Logging backend can be configured to store the logging information locally and that configuration would be kept in the Machine-specific man- ifest. Furthermore, the output channel on Ethernet for Log messages is configured with the PlatformModuleEthernetEndpointConfiguration that is referenced byDltLogSink in the role endpointConfiguration.
